Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. That does not mean there is no more cricketing action for the day. You all can surely switch tabs and follow the final Test match between England and India. Coming back to this series, India Women have sealed this series as well and these two sides will meet again for the final game of the series. It will be played on July 7th. The first ball will be at 1000 IST (0430 GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build up. Till then, take care and goodbye.

Renuka Singh wins the PLAYER OF THE MATCH AWARD for her exceptional spell with the new ball. She says she is working on her variations and focusing on hitting the hard length. Adds that they assessed the wicket early in the morning, so the plan was to win the toss and bowl well. Shares that they kept it simple, to play to the basics and focus on her strengths.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the victorious skipper is in for a chat. She says they have been talking about the long partnerships and she is really happy to see it finally coming all together. Mentions they focus in the team meeting that every match is a new opportunity and is glad the players lived up to the expectations. Futher adds she is very happy to use the several bowlers at her disposal.

Chamari Atapattu, the Sri Lanka Women skipper says India bowled really well in the start but their bowlers were not good enough and dropped a couple of catches as well. Adds that there should be responsible and the plyers need to improve. On herself, she will try to bat for a longer period as that is her role.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the innings, the Indian bowlers did enough to justify their skipper's decision of bowling first. Renuka Singh was on fire. She picked up three wickets inside Powerplay 1. Even Meghna Singh kept the pressure on the batters with excellent line and length. The spinners also did their job in the middle over and squeezed the run flow. If not for the stand between Anushka Sanjeewani and Nilakshi de Silva, Sri Lanka Women would've bundled out quite early. Later, India chased down the target of 174 without any hiccups.

Sri Lanka looked lackluster with the ball. Their bowling was not up to the mark. They were either too short or too full. Unlike, India they could not maintain the pressure at the start. They lacked in the field as well, with a couple of dropped chances along with leaving huge gaps in the field which allowed the batters to keep rotating the strike. In the end, Sri Lanka were unable to keep their hopes alive to win the series.

In the last ODI match, India chased down a similar target in 38 overs but this time they only required 25.4 overs to get over the line. This tells you everything about the Indian innings. The opening pair was enough for them to get over the line. Smriti Mandhana racked up 94 runs, while Shafali Verma recorded her best score in ODI with an unbeaten 71 off 71 balls. This innings was unlike the Verma we all know. She played a very mature innings and has helped her side to get over the line. All smile in the Indian camp.

A dominating performance by India Women sees them take an unassailable lead in this series. The hosts were unable to put up a fight this time around. India win the game convincingly by 10 wickets here.
This is full and outside off. Verma drives it to the right of cover for a single. India win the series as they win this match by 10 wickets.
Two wides! Mandhana has a smile as she runs across! Full and down the leg side. Mandhana makes room and looks to sweep but misses. The keeper gets a hand on it and the batters take a single.
SIX! Just three runs needed now! Mandhana needs a six for a century! On a length and on middle. Mandhana gets on her knee and slog-sweeps it over deep square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Too full and on off. Mandhana shows the full face of the bat and drives it through mid off for a boundary. Timed so well there.
Tossed up, outside off. Verma steps across and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, outside off. Verma punches it to long off for another single. Runs are coming in easily for the visiting side.
Full and on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it through covers for one.
Outside off, Mandhana dabs it down to point.
Flatter and outside off. Verma pushes it to cover for one.
On the pads, tucked to deep square leg for one.
Touch short, outside off. Verma lofts it to mid off. It lands in between the two fielders. They take one.

Brilliant effort in the deep. It is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana lofts it over the bowler's head. Nilakshi de Silva sprints to her right from long on and puts in a late dive to save a boundary. She might've hurt herself in the process. She is taken off the field by the physio.
Fuller, on the pads, Smriti Mandhana gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
A single as this is pushed down to long off.
WIDE! Fuller and quicker, down leg. Shafali Verma tries to paddle it away but fails. Wided.
Full, on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana makes room and lofts it over point for a brace.
Fuller, on middle and leg, Mandhana defends it back to the bowler.
SIX! BOOM! Shafali Verma moves to 65, Her best score in ODI so far. It is full and on off. Shafali Verma is down on one knee and she slogs it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Strayed on the pads, Smriti Mandhana flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Verma flicks it to long on for one.
This is outside off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it through covers for one.
Fuller, on off, driven to long off for a single.
In the air, but safe! Nonetheless a valiant effort in the deep. It is outside off. Verma slogs it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder dives forward but is unable to grab it cleanly.
On a length, on middle. Verma pushes it to long on for one. India cruising at the moment.
Tossed up, outside off, Smriti Mandhana does not time it well but luckliy the fielder is near the circle. It lands safely at long off and they take one.
FOUR! It is falling apart for Sri Lanka now. It is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana gets down on one knee and slogs it over mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Exquisite shot! It is full and on off. Smriti Mandhana picks it up nicely and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Full length, on middle. Verma clips it to long on for a single.
Full length, on off. Verma pushes it to long off for a brace.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is in her grrove. This is sprayed down leg. Smriti Mandhana swivels and hoicks it through square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! This way outside off, Smriti Mandhana does not chase it and the umpire signals a wide.
Around off, Verma shuffles across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana goes back and punches it wide of point for one.
Tossed up and full, on off, Verma flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. That will be fifty for Verma, her first one of this series.
Flatter, outside off. Verma dabs it to backward point.
Full length, on the pads, Verma clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Evades the fielder! Tossed up on middle. Mandhana makes room and steps down as she smashes it to long off, over the fielder in the deep for a boundary.
Full again and Verma comes down the track and heaves it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Verma eases it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and outside off, turning in. Mandhana steers it to third man for a single.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller and sliding on middle, drilled to long on for one more.
On the pads, whipped to square leg where the fielder makes a half-stop. A single.
Too full and on off, played back to the bowler.
Down the leg side. Mandhana bunts it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, Mandhana works it to point.
Wide! This one lands outside off and spins more away. Mandhana leaves it alone.
FOUR! 100 up for India! Short one on middle. Mandhana rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
On off, kept out.
Slower one, angling on the pads. Verma tickles it straight to short fine leg. 75 runs needed more.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Mandhana fails to play at it.
Dropped! Another one goes down! Tossed up on middle. Mandhana chips it straight back to the bowler. Inoka Ranaweera gets low to take it but spills it down. Another sitter goes down.

Fifty for Smriti Mandhana! 23rd fifty for the Indian opener. She will be very happy to get some runs here. Shorter, slower and outside off. Mandhana delicately dabs it to third man for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, around off. Verma wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, Shafali Verma tucks it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
A googly, outside off. Mandhana punches it to deep cover for a single.
Extra bounce this time, shorter and on middle. Mandhana rushes as she blocks it.
Flatter and around off. Mandhana hangs back and looks to push but gets a thick inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter and on middle. Verma tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Too full and around off. Mandhana watchfully pushes it to long off for a single.

Drinks! India Women have everything under control. Their opening pair of Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana has contributed equally with both edging closer to their respective half centuries. Sri Lanka bowlers have hardly been able to cause any trouble. Only a miracle can get them back into the game. Chamari Atapattu gets herself into the attack.
Slower, fuller and on off, pushed to long off for a single. India Women need 83 more runs to win.
Around leg. Mandhana keeps it out.
Flatter and on off. Verma steps across and clips it to deep square leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Dropped! Sri Lanka Women cannot miss this type of chance! This is full and on off. Verma comes down the track and heaves it straight to long on where Nilakshi de Silva gets low and tries to take it but drops a dolly. Should've been taken. A single.
On middle, punched through covers for a single.
Short, on the pads, Verma flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
Full and on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to mid on for one.
Deft touch! Smart batting from Smriti Mandhana. Tossed up, outside off. Smriti Mandhana guides it down to third man. The fielder gives it a chase and saves the boundary. Two runs taken.
Loopy ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana dabs it to backward point.
Shafali Verma drives this full delivery to long off for one.
Flatter outside off. Shafali Verma looks to cut it away but gets it on a bounce to slips.
On middle and leg, Verma flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, pushed past point for one.
WIDE! Lucky for Kavisha Dilhari. This one had four written all over it. It is quicker, short and down leg. Smriti Mandhana looks to whack it to long on but misses. Wide called.
Fuller, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it through covers for two. Really good running.
Looped up, around middle. Smriti Mandhana blocks it into the deck.
Flighted and full, outside off. Verma shuffles across and clips it to long on for one.
Smriti Mandhana drives this full delivery down the ground and takes a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana punches it past point for a single.
FOUR! This is Smriti Mandhana at her best! It is tossed up, outside off. Smriti Mandhana dances down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
On off, pushed to covers.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Verma clips it through mid-wicket for just a single.
Tossed up, wide of off. Verma blocks it back to the bowler.
WIDE! This is sprayed down leg. Verma tries to glance it away but misses.
Darted on the pads, Mandhana clips it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! It is short, outside off. Verma goes back and saps it past extra covers and finds the boundary.
Touch short, on off, Verma shuffles and flicks it to the leg side.
Tossed up, around off, Verma defends it out.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter one, outside off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back to punch it to deep point for one.
Touch short, on off. Verma goes back and lofts it towards long on for a single.
Around middle and leg, Verma clips it through mid-wicket for a single. This has been a solid start for India.
Yet again angled down leg. Verma gets hit on the pads. No trouble there.
Wide! This is srayed down the leg side. Wide called.
Short ball, wide of off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it hard to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off. Verma flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, outside off. Verma stays back and punches it to covers.
Floated and full, on off. Verma eases it back to the bowler.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end. Now, 4 fielders can be placed inside the inner circle until the end of the 40th over. Also, Inoka Ranaweera is into the attack now.
FOUR! That is a gorgeous drive! Overpitched and outside off. Mandhana leans and drives it through covers. No chance of stopping it and bags a boundary.
On off, pushed to covers.
Good fielding once again! Length and on off, Mandhana punches it to covers where the fielder dives to her left and stops it.
Nicely driven but for no run! This is full and on middle, hit to mid on.
Tad full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Good stop there! A length ball, outside off. Verma slaps it to point where the fielder dives to her left and makes a solid stop. Only a single.
Outside off, on a length. Mandhana taps it to point.
Length and on middle, Mandhana works it back to the bowler.
Kulasuriya bowls a slower one, full and Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
On the pads this time, it is pushed to mid on.
FOUR! 50 up for India! On a length and on middle. Mandhana hangs back and nudges it through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller and outside off. Mandhana works it to covers.
Slower one on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Length and on middle, played to long on for one more.

FOUR! Clears the infield! A length ball, outside off. Verma tries to cut but it goes off the thick outside edge, over and past point. The fielder gives a chase but fails to keep it away from the fence.
Length ball, outside off, going away with the angle. Verma throws her bat but hits to point.
Full and on the pads. Mandhana flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On off, Mandhana punches it to covers.
FOUR! Innovative! Verma loves to play this shot! This is full and around off. Verma shuffles across and paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off, Verma punches it hard but straight to cover.
On a length and on top of off. Verma hits it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Mandhana dabs it to cover-point, not in the gap.
Length ball, outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Six singles off the over then! Floated ball, outside off. Verma steps across and hits it to long on for one run.
India cruising firmly! Fuller and outside off, driven to long off for one.
Too full and around off. Verma smashes it to long on for one more.
Flatter and on middle. Mandhana hangs back and punches it to long off for one.
A flighted delivery, full and outside off. Verma comes down the track but does not reach to the pitch of the ball quite well. She hits it over mid off for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Mandhana drives it to long off for a single.
Full length, outside off. Shafali Verma lofts it over covers and gets a brace. A great over for India. 10 runs off it.
Shafali Verma using her feet yet again. It is on a length, outside off. Varma pushes it to covers but does not find the gap.
Good length, outside off. Verma shuffles across and punches it towards point. The fielder misfields and the batters take two.
WIDE! Length ball, spraying down leg. Verma tries to tickle it fine but gets no blade on it. Wide called.
FOUR! Shafali Verma picks it up really well. It is full, on middle and leg. Verma dances down the track and lofts it over mid on for an easy boundary.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.
Fraction short, on middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Mandhana comes down the track and drives it to long off for a single.
On off, defended out.
Tossed up, outside off. Verma shuffles across and hits it to long on for one.
Looped up, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Mandhana pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is finding her rhythm here. It is short and on middle. Smriti Mandhana swivels on the back foot and pulls it past square leg for a boundary. Pressue on the bowler straightaway.

Shafali Verma is not a player who likes dot balls. She tries to break the shackles here. It is on a length, outside off. Verma skips down the track and drives it hard to covers but straight to the fielder.
Short ball, outside off. Verma pushes it to the left of the bowler. Achini Kulasuriya dives to that side and makes a solid stop.
In the air but safe! This is full and stright on the pads. Smriti Mandhana is a tad early into her shot and clips it aerially towards mid-wicket. It lands safely and they take one.
Length and on off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out on the back foot.
On a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out watchfully.
Back of a length, outside off. Verma cuts it to deep point for a single.
Looped up, around off. Smriti Mandhana tries to play with the turn but this one straightens. She misses and gets hit high on her thigh pad.

FOUR! Short and punished! Smriti Mandhana gets the first boundary of the chase. It is short, on off. Smriti Mandhana swivels on her back foot and pulls it over square leg. The fielder leaps but the ball evades her effort and runs away for four.
On off, Verma works it to long on for one.
Fraction short, on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it to square leg for one.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana moves back and pushes it to covers.
Flatter, around off. Smriti Mandhana dabs it down to point.
Oshadi Ranasinghe to bowl from the other end.
Four dot balls on the trot to end the over. A great start for Achini Kulasuriya. It is full, just outside off. Shafali Verma fends it to point.
Length ball, outside off, blocked out.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, on the fourth stump, it stays low off the deck. Shafali Verma comes down the track and tries to push it away but misses.
Length ball, on off. Verma defends it to covers on the front foot.
Full length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover and gets off the mark.

Achini Kulasuriya starts with a full-length delivery, outside off. Shafali Verma times it well but straight to the fielder at covers. It is hit hard and the fielder fumbles. The batters get enough time to sneak a single.
